title: Grateful Dead Live at The Music Box on 1969-04-15
lineage: CD -> EAC -> Samplitude Professional v7.02 -> FLAC
source: Aiwa hand-held microphone -> Master Reel (Aiwa 5" reel-to-reel) -> Alesis Masterlink 9600 -> Hard Drive -> CD

ai_review.summary: Warm audience recording of a high‑energy 1969 show highlighted by a monster Dark Star and fiery Other One despite modest sound quality.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its powerful Other One and an unforgettable Dark Star, with Jerry Garcia’s guitar work described as “on fire.”  Though captured on a handheld mic with limited fidelity, the recording conveys the intimate atmosphere of the Music Box and is considered enjoyable by listeners.  Overall the show delivers high energy after a slow start, making it a standout early‑Dead concert.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews consistently give 4–5 stars for the musical performance; the show is rated very highly while recording quality is noted as modest, yielding a weighted average around 4.1.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Handheld mic capture with limited detail and some muddiness; warmth and atmosphere are present but fidelity is low compared to soundboard sources.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Starts a bit tentative for the first two numbers, then quickly builds into high‑energy playing with a soaring Dark Star and a fiery Other One, reflecting the intimate crowd interaction at the Music Box.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers note Jerry’s guitar is on fire, with expressive pedal‑steel‑inspired leads and double bends.
